vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: Policy normalization materializes the Cartesian product of attacker-controlled ExactlyOne alternatives. Repeated binary alternatives make the output 2^N, causing unbounded heap allocation. Commit 9069bcf9d401fbcfff834f26248845f8d51da4b5 adds MAX_ALTERNATIVES=10000 inside getCrossProduct, and child commit 3099a3f37885fc6fa5c69a7d41a097b78b6beb73 supplies a 75-level binary reproducer expecting RuntimeException.

atomic_bic.evidence: The atomic BIC is 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3, not repository root ae621abb456e212f7e4038c0ccae1bd5542c5805. The root implementation only formed pairwise products and omitted the full N-way alternative set. 05ce replaced that loop with recursive Policy.crossProduct over all terms, creating the exact exponential 2^N mechanism later ported and refactored into AbstractPolicyOperator.getCrossProduct.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Immediate parent 33d3be55ef6f8b96018dd683af8175adb080226b is locally present and contains the older pairwise i/j implementation; it has neither Policy.crossProduct nor the recursive all-terms expansion added by 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3 is a single-parent patch landing, not a merge or squash with hidden commit members. Its message points to WSCOMMONS-19; the Jira record and attachment WS-COMMONS-19.zip (SHA-256 e82b482467daacf1ea0662a7ba4996b60881f6034c7a40bb71af22b7935b657d) contain the recursive crossProduct patch and attribute it to reporter/attachment author Paul Nolan. Later 64241dd3841a8fc137f48f1a1ef62fab7eaceef5, 24c60d6c359ca1b9dd7e1b830ab4f114683a3331, and 1a8ffd6d39234d3e9615de52f818a78d113e8029 are ports/refactors, not new BICs.

Annotated tag neethi-3.2.2 resolves to 2351df23093e1bd4b2d2c8f9630e95e929a5de4e and contains both the BIC and fix. This matches the Apache CNA CVE record's affected range 0 to less than 3.2.2.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: Direct fix 9069bcf9d401fbcfff834f26248845f8d51da4b5 changes only AbstractPolicyOperator.java, adds MAX_ALTERNATIVES=10000, and throws after the accumulated cross-product exceeds the cap. The following test commit exercises the same exponential normalization path.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: AI attribution is evaluated on BIC 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3 and its decomposed patch provenance, not on the 2026 fix. The 2006-05-05 Jira issue and attachment identify Paul Nolan as reporter and patch author; the Git commit identifies Sanka Samaranayake as author/committer and has no trailers or AI/bot markers. The 2006 provenance predates modern generative coding assistants, closing human authorship and supporting NOT_AI.

findings: Primary verdict NOT_AI is substantively correct, but its atomic introducer is wrong.

Repository root ae621abb456e212f7e4038c0ccae1bd5542c5805 had an uncapped but pairwise-only normalization loop; it did not implement the full recursive N-way Cartesian product described by the advisory and reproducer.
WSCOMMONS-19 commit 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3 first introduced the exact recursive all-terms product, and its immediate parent proves absence.
The external patch provenance changes the causal writer from the root commit's Sanjiva Weerawarana to Paul Nolan, with Sanka Samaranayake as landing committer.

corrected_fields.flaw_origin: The exact exponential N-way Cartesian-product mechanism was introduced by 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3 when the WSCOMMONS-19 patch replaced the prior pairwise loop with recursive Policy.crossProduct over every child ExactlyOne. The code was subsequently ported into Neethi 2 and refactored into getCrossProduct without removing the unbounded allocation.
corrected_fields.ai_marker: absent: WSCOMMONS-19 Jira and attachment metadata identify Paul Nolan as the 2006 patch author; commit 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3 identifies Sanka Samaranayake as author/committer and contains no AI/bot trailers or markers. The BIC predates modern generative coding assistants.
corrected_fields.reasoning: The advisory's 2^N behavior requires the full product across all child alternatives. The root implementation only combined pairs and was replaced by WSCOMMONS-19's recursive all-terms algorithm in 05ce870322fb9c50d7cdf1c65e403a08379572b3; that commit is therefore the smallest first-write of the exact mechanism. Parent-tree inspection, later port/refactor history, release topology, and the direct cap fix all close. Human patch provenance in 2006 keeps the causal verdict NOT_AI.
